title: FlipOff: split-flap display emulator for any TV, The classic flip-board look without $3,500 hardware

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Want a $3,500 retro airport display for free? Someone tried charging 200 bucks for a web version, so a developer got mad and built Flip Off out of pure open-source spite. It runs entirely in your browser with zero dependencies. Just hit full screen to turn any monitor into a stunning mechanical flipboard complete with authentic clacking
